claims.statement: Broker credentials are never persisted: the external password and OTP exist only for the duration of a login call, and what survives is an integration_users row (user, institution, external username, display name) plus a broker session token cached in the OS keyring by the gateway.

Position sync is a full replace per account: PositionApi.create groups incoming positions by account_id and delegates to PositionRepository.sync_by_account, which deletes every position row for the account before inserting the new set.

Every broker position is resolved to a market Security before being written: SecurityApi.get_or_create_from_broker checks SecurityBrokerRepository for an existing mapping, otherwise maps the broker symbol/exchange, searches the market gateway (via SecuritySearchCache), takes the first result and upserts both the Security and the SecurityBroker mapping.
GET /api/v1/integration/institutions returns only institutions with integrations enabled, which is the sole filter determining which institutions a user can connect in the UI.

POST /external/{institution}/login resolves the broker gateway from the path enum and calls IntegrationUserService.get_or_create before attempting login, so the integration_users record exists even when login fails; OTPRequiredError maps to HTTP 400 with detail OTP_REQUIRED and LoginFailedError to HTTP 401 with detail INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

WealthsimpleApiGateway.login first tries the cached keyring session and probes it with get_accounts(); only when no session exists does it perform a real credential login via ws.login_internal with persist_session_fct=_save_session.

The frontend broker login modal keys off the literal error strings: OTP_REQUIRED switches the form into the OTP step and INVALID_CREDENTIALS renders 'Invalid username or password', with any other error falling back to a generic message.

POST /external/accounts/import (rate-limited 3/minute) validates ownership with AuthorizationApi.check_entity_owned_by_user, lists broker accounts, filters them to the requested external_account_ids, imports non-duplicate accounts via AccountApi.import_from_broker, and enqueues one sync_account_positions_task per newly imported account.

POST /external/positions/import is a separate synchronous variant that performs the same symbol-resolution and position-write work inline in the request instead of on the Huey worker, and is not rate-limited.

sync_account_positions_task is a Huey task that runs in the huey-worker process, asserts huey.svcs_registry is set (raising RuntimeError otherwise), and runs its async body under asyncio.run inside a fresh svcs Container.

_do_sync_positions enforces ordering and guards: it raises AccountPositionsSyncError when account.integration_user_id is None and IntegrationUserNotFoundError when the integration user row is missing, then fetches broker positions, resolves securities, writes positions, and finally updates net_deposits and last_sync_at from a re-listed broker account.

Sync bookkeeping is a Redis set account_syncs:active:{user_id}: mark_sync_started SADDs the account id and sets settings.sync_ttl_seconds expiry (default 300), mark_sync_finished SREMs it, and get_active_syncs returns the members as AccountId UUIDs.

mark_sync_finished is called in a finally block so it runs on both success and failure, mark_sync_started failures are only logged and never abort the sync, and a huey SIGNAL_INTERRUPTED handler clears the sync status for an interrupted sync_account_positions_task.
GET /api/v1/accounts/sync-status returns the authenticated user's active sync account ids and maps a redis.RedisError to HTTP 503 'Sync status service unavailable'.

The sync task emits exactly three WebSocket events with wire values sync_started, sync_finished and sync_failed, each an AccountSyncMessage serialized with model_dump(mode='json'): sync_started before any broker call, sync_finished after the sync body, and sync_failed in the except branch after the error-email attempt and before re-raising.

WebSocket fan-out is Redis pub/sub backed: ConnectionManager.send_personal_message publishes {user_id, message} on channel ws_messages with one Redis client per running event loop, falling back to local-only delivery when Redis is unreachable, and the listener task restarts itself after a 5 second delay on unexpected error.

The WebSocket endpoint /api/ws authenticates via a single-use signed ticket (URLSafeTimedSerializer, salt 'ws-ticket', max_age 30) with replay detection through a SHA-256 hash key set with nx=True and ex=30, closing with code 1008 on failure, and also accepts an auth cookie or sec-websocket-protocol token as an alternative.
AccountsListState obtains a WebSocket ticket via authService.getWsTicket and, when no ticket is returned, logs a warning and aborts the connection rather than connecting unauthenticated.

AccountsListState tracks sync via syncingAccountIds (a SvelteSet) and syncErrors: sync_started adds the id and clears the error, sync_finished removes it and clears the error, and sync_failed removes it and sets 'Failed to sync. Please try again.'

On WebSocket open the accounts list hydrates the sync badge from GET /accounts/sync-status once (guarded by syncStatusHydrated), and on close it resets that guard and reconnects after a fixed 5 second setTimeout.

syncAccount POSTs the sync endpoint and then runs waitForSyncFinish, a bounded poll (60s deadline, 1.5s interval) of the sync-status endpoint with a 5 second grace period for the WS message; this fallback exists because Redis pub/sub delivery of the finish event may fail, and it clears state and refetches accounts when the backend no longer reports the id.

POST /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/sync (rate-limited 3/minute) returns HTTP 400 when api_sync_enabled is false, delegates to PositionService.sync_account_positions, which re-checks the flag raising ApiSyncDisabledError and silently returns when account.integration_user_id is None, and finally enqueues the Huey task via IntegrationAccountApi.

_SYNC_ERROR_MESSAGE_MAPPING maps SessionExpiredError, SessionDoesNotExistError, OTPRequiredError, LoginFailedError, IntegrationUserNotFoundError and ExternalAPIError to distinct user-facing sentences; AccountPositionsSyncError is handled first using its own message (with a default when empty) and any unmapped exception falls through to a generic unexpected-error sentence.

_send_sync_error_email resolves the recipient via UserApi.get_email_for_user, derives the institution label from InstitutionEnum name with a fallback to str(account.institution_id) for unmapped ids, and sends an ExternalAccountErrorEmailData with the deeplink {settings.frontend_url}/accounts; the whole attempt is wrapped so an email failure is only logged and a missing user email only warns.

tests/tasks/test_integration.py pins the sync task's success path (resolved security, update_net_deposits with the broker value, update_last_sync_at, and exactly two send_personal_message calls ordered sync_started then sync_finished) and one test per error-mapping entry asserting the exact email body and frontend_url deeplink, including sync_failed as the last socket call when the email itself throws.

Tests must never use live broker gateways or Redis: tests/conftest.py sets STUB_EXTERNAL_API=true before the app import, the autouse fake_redis_manager fixture replaces redis_manager.client with a dict-backed FakeRedis implementing sadd/srem/smembers, and global_mocks forces huey.immediate=True and patches ConnectionManager.send_personal_message.

Adding a new broker institution requires a BrokerApiGateway subclass with its own keyring prefix and InstitutionEnum, an entry in get_broker_gateway_class (which currently raises KeyError for any institution other than WEALTHSIMPLE), vendor-error translation onto ExternalAPIError subclasses, a stub under src/stubs/, and a registration in src/integration/registry.py.

Broker gateways installed on both the live and stub path store Wealthsimple session tokens unencrypted on disk because BrokerApiGateway.__init__ calls keyring.set_keyring(PlaintextKeyring()) from keyrings.alt.file, guarded only by a TODO comment.

Institution listing is filtered in the repository: get_all_enabled_integrations selects institutions where integration_enabled is True, and only that flag decides which institutions the connect UI can show.

WealthsimpleApiGateway.login translates every vendor failure into an ExternalAPIError subclass: LoginFailedException to LoginFailedError, OTPRequiredException to OTPRequiredError, ManualLoginRequired to SessionExpiredError and UnexpectedException to UnknownError, and it raises LoginFailedError when no cached session exists and the caller supplied no password.

POST /external/positions/import is rate-limited 3/minute like the accounts import route, and it remains a synchronous variant that writes positions inline in the request rather than on the Huey worker.

Wealthsimple session tokens are namespaced per external username in the keyring under the service name retail_portfolio_wealthsimple.{username} with key "session", and BrokerApiGateway.__init__ installs keyrings.alt.file.PlaintextKeyring so that material is unencrypted on disk.

The sync failure email renders ExternalAccountErrorEmailData through EmailService.send_external_account_error_email into the external_account_error.html/.txt templates with the subject 'Sync Error: {account_name} ({institution_name})'.

The Huey instance backing the sync task is a MemoryHueyWithRegistry under ENVIRONMENT=test and a RedisHueyWithRegistry bound to settings.redis_url otherwise, and on worker startup the svcs registry is built with a NullPool DatabaseSessionManager because tasks cycle through asyncio.run().

Adding a broker also requires registering a stub gateway in src/config/services.py::register_integration_stub_services, because stub selection happens at registry-construction time based on settings.stub_external_api rather than inside get_broker_gateway_class.

tests/integration/brokers/test_wealthsimple.py drives the gateway entirely through StubWealthsimpleAPI/StubWSAPISession with keyring patched, covering session save/get, the login translation paths, account parsing with and without netDeposits, the positional edge cases (cash position, malformed market data, unsupported primary exchange) and the helper symbol/exchange mappings.

tests/tasks/test_integration.py also pins the Redis bookkeeping contract directly: mark_sync_started is awaited once at the beginning and mark_sync_finished once at the end on both the success path and a broker failure path.
